rationale: clean proposition control
documentation comment must not create placeholder policy
nested block-comment token must be inert
multiline commented axiom must be inert
policy words inside an ordinary string must be inert
escaped quote must not terminate policy string erasure
escaped identifier text equal to a policy keyword must be inert
line-commented axiom must be inert
mixed non-code policy tokens must all be inert
actual placeholder anywhere in artifact violates declared file policy
actual custom axiom anywhere in artifact violates declared file policy
malformed binder should be rejected in frontend
well-formed source with type-invalid proof should reject during elaboration
accepted declaration proves a different target
explicitly disabling autoImplicit makes unknown type reject
default autoImplicit can generalize the type parameter and instantiate it at Nat
scanner must ignore comment token while retaining the real placeholder
nested block comment containing string-like text remains inert
documentation block containing axiom syntax must be inert
different theorem name and two-argument shape should remain target-matching
